messages:
mira: Scheduling a schema change tonight in the 02:00-03:00 UTC maintenance window. It's a small column removal on orders.line_item_additional_data + an indexed constraint cleanup. Plan is: phased backfill (chunked), then constraint validate, then drop. Will use deploybot canary with tenant slices (green1 -> green2 -> all).
jon: Sounds good. Do we need a service pin while the backfill runs? If app reads the column we might get errors.
mira: Yes — recommend pin api-service to v2.5.1 for the window. We'll also set the feature flag to tolerate missing field for the canary wave. I'll post the release notes blurb shortly.
leo: Add an escape hatch: if average lock time > 5m or p99 write latency regresses > 25% for 3 consecutive minutes, abort canary and roll back migration. Who's owning the rollback call? ops_watch?
ops_watch: I'll monitor. Criteria: lock wait > 5m OR >1% transaction aborts OR replication lag > 30s on any replica. If triggered I'll send: "ops_watch: ABORT MIGRATION — HOLD ALL WAVES" and pin the migration job to paused. Also set the deploybot rollback flag.
\
mira: Deploybot job created: migration-job-1775309123. Canary slices: green1 (100 tenants), green2 (500), then wide. Backfill will chunk with max 10k rows/tx and 2s sleep between chunks. Using online constraint validation with `CONCURRENT VALIDATE` pattern.
deploybot: migration-job-1775309123 queued by mira. Resource: pg-primary-2, backfill-runner-3. Canary plan: 1/3 -> 2/3 -> full. Auto-fallback: if canary fails, revert schema change on canary nodes and unroll constraint for remaining waves.
tara: Can you add a short smoke check we can run post-canary? I can run a few queries: select count(*) on orders where line_item_additional_data is null and compare to expected before/after.
mira: Good idea. Smoke checks: 1) `SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '5 minutes'` 2) `SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE line_item_additional_data IS NOT NULL LIMIT 5` 3) call a sample endpoint: `GET /orders/:id` for 3 ids from green1. If anything 500s, abort.
jon: Also ensure migration job has a manual hold flag. If we see lock escalation we can pause between waves.
deploybot: CANARY STARTED: migration-job-1775309123 on green1 (100 tenants). Logs: 
```
starting chunk 1/12 (0-10000)
applied 10000 rows in 1.9s, lock_time=120ms
sleep 2s
```
mira: Watching logs. Initial chunk latency looks fine. No lock spikes.
ops_watch: Observed a brief lock bump to 1.2s but not above threshold. Replication lag 2s. p99 write latency stable.
deploybot: CANARY PROGRESS: 4/12 chunks complete. Current chunk lock_time avg=90ms. Canary metrics: errors=0, tx_aborts=0, replication_lag=3s.
leo: OK to move green2 after 2 more chunks unless ops_watch raises hold.
ops_watch: green2 go-ahead, no abort criteria met.
deploybot: EXPANDING: starting green2 wave (500 tenants). Logs: 
```
starting chunk 1/60 (0-10000)
applied 10000 rows in 2.2s, lock_time=160ms
```
tara: Running smoke checks on green1 samples: endpoint GET /orders/6421 returned 200, payload missing field as expected, no 500s. Row counts matching expected delta.
mira: Reminder: release notes line for change window: "Remove legacy line_item_additional_data column (migrated to JSONB payload). Backfill will run in phased waves; app pinned to v2.5.1 during the window. Contact #eng-releases if issues." Keep short.
deploybot: ALERT: chunk 12/60 on green2 reported a spike: lock_time=6.3m, tx_aborts=0. ops_watch please confirm.
ops_watch: I see it — lock_time threshold breached. ABORT MIGRATION — HOLD ALL WAVES. Pinning migration-job-1775309123 to paused. Notify DB team for immediate investigation.
mira: Acknowledged. Pausing and reverting canary changes on green2. Setting feature flag back to previous. Rolling back pinned service? We should keep api-service pinned until we confirm schema state.
jon: I'll run the diagnostic query to find long-running transaction: `SELECT pid, query, state, now() - query_start as runtime FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle' AND query LIKE '%UPDATE orders%' ORDER BY runtime DESC LIMIT 5;`
deploybot: ROLLBACK ACTIONS TRIGGERED: paused migration-job-1775309123, queued revert tasks for green2 applied chunks (best-effort), notifying on-call DB.
ops_watch: DB on-call @leo-db joining. Preliminary cause: a hot partition on customer_id=42 caused one chunk to touch many rows; increased lock waits. Recommendation: rerun with smaller chunk target for offending partition and use per-customer throttling.
leo: For next attempt propose: dynamic chunk sizing — reduce to 1k rows/tx for high-cardinality customers, and add per-customer backoff. Also propose a dry-run of constraint validate with `VALIDATE CONCURRENTLY` on a replica to estimate contention.
mira: Good post-mortem notes. Immediate next steps: 1) keep migration paused and service pinned v2.5.1, 2) DB team to prepare adjusted chunker with per-customer limits, 3) schedule a re-run in a smaller maintenance window (01:00-02:00 UTC) after fixes. I'll file a short release note update and send a calendar invite for rehearse.
tara: I'll run a small local simulation of chunk behavior against a snapshot and post metrics in this thread.
mira: Thanks everyone. Filing postmortem and tagging this thread: will include timeline, root cause (hot partition chunk), and mitigation (dynamic chunk sizing + stricter abort thresholds). If ops_watch clears, we'll unpin the service. Current thread will stay open until re-run scheduled"
